name: Nelson Lyle

nadir.desc: The property consists of a single large primary residence with a brown shingle roof and irregular building footprint|A wide concrete driveway and parking area is located along the right side of the house, with one vehicle parked on the pavement|A smaller detached structure is situated near the main building|The lot includes landscaped areas with trees, shrubs, rock features, and some flowering plants, particularly along the perimeter and front yard areas.

alpha.desc: The front of the residence features a covered entry area with multiple windows visible along the façade|A large concrete driveway provides vehicle access, with two vehicles parked on the pavement|Dense hedging runs along the front of the property, with mature trees located on both the left and right sides of the structure.

bravo.desc: The left side of the residence shows significant mature tree coverage and landscaping immediately adjacent to the building|Rock features and vegetation are visible along this elevation|Limited building openings are present on this side of the structure.

charlie.desc: The rear of the residence includes a paved area with a white SUV parked|Some equipment and storage items are visible on the ground near the building|Mature trees and landscaping border the rear of the property.

delta.desc: The right side of the residence shows two garage doors and a concrete driveway with a white pickup truck parked|Dense trees and landscaping are present on both sides of the driveway|A portion of another vehicle is visible near the edge of the image.

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a wide concrete driveway that supports circulation along the right side of the house and into the parking area. Parking space is available adjacent to the structure. Dense tree coverage and landscaping along multiple sides of the building may limit visibility and movement in those areas. The rear of the property appears accessible via the driveway. Some equipment and items stored near the rear of the house may affect clear movement in that area.
